text: いろんな　ニュースが　よめて　おもしろいのう　うむ　まんぞくじゃ！

structure.jp: いろんな　ニュースが　よめて
structure.en: being able to read all sorts of news

structure.jp: うむ　まんぞくじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing よむ to よめる turns 'read' into 'can read'. The thing you can read takes が. ニュースが　よめて = 'being able to read news'.

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.span: よめて　おもしろい
patterns.explanation: The て-form before a feeling gives the reason for that feeling. よめて　おもしろい = 'it is fun because I can read them'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'. まんぞくじゃ = 'I am satisfied'.
